svg.title: The toolbox checks the test really failed first, instead of taking anyone's word for it — A launch that cannot reach its scenarios cannot reuse an earlier report
svg.text: The toolbox checks the test really failed first, instead
of taking anyone's word for it
Scenario: A launch that cannot reach its scenarios cannot reuse an earlier report
An earlier failure is not proof for the next launch
A filter that selects nothing is an error

g.text: Given an earlier launch has a genuine failed scenario and accepted RED
A disposable scenario really fails on an assertion. The repository's reporter writes its
failure, and the RED gate accepts that current evidence.
When the next launch crashes before loading its scenarios
The next launch throws while loading its configuration, before it can execute any scenario.
This uses the engine command from the task's own preview.
Then the RED gate refuses the old failure and no worker report remains
The same RED command must now refuse the proof. The previous report must be gone, even
though configuration loading failed before a new report could be written.
And a zero-match filter fails clearly and removes earlier reports
A real successful launch seeds reports again. A filter matching no scenario must fail
clearly and leave no result from that earlier launch.
